intended_message: Counterpart appears to agree with per-user pricing but reveals they think one seat can be shared across the team

turns.speaker: wearer
turns.text: So just to recap, it's named seats on the Team plan, so everyone who logs in needs their own seat to access the workspace.

turns.speaker: wearer
turns.text: Exactly. And if someone leaves you can deactivate them and reassign that seat to someone else for free.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: Yeah, makes sense. So could we just get like two seats and have the whole support team share the logins for those?
